subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Does current main's history request and mutation-generation guard already cover the reported overlapping same-session responses, or does Apple chat need an additional single-flight or identity/sequence reconciliation change?
rationale: The existing state machine already contains overlapping-request safeguards, while the report supplies strong v2026.7.1 field evidence but not the exact current-main event schedule needed to distinguish a missing guard from a projection or identity defect.

options.title: Require deterministic replay first
options.body: Capture the competing live-event and history-response order in a focused Apple view-model regression test, then implement only the invariant that the test proves missing.

options.title: Prove current main live
options.body: Reproduce the same tool-using sequence on current main with request IDs and sequence metadata captured, closing only if repeated runs converge correctly.

options.title: Treat projection separately
options.body: Split tool-step flattening into a narrower follow-up if ordering converges but typed tool rows still render as ordinary assistant content.

recommendation.title: Require deterministic replay first
recommendation.body: Capture the competing live-event and history-response order in a focused Apple view-model regression test, then implement only the invariant that the test proves missing.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad recent history/live ordering refactor makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for deciding the proof threshold and owner boundary.
